summary: Implement the frozen privacy/data-governance capability with canonical data classes, tenant-scoped purpose/legal-basis and retention registries, PII redaction for operational metadata, and PostgreSQL RLS enforcement without introducing a new architecture pillar.

impacts.evidence: Purpose and retention registries carry organization/workspace scope, use composite workspace foreign keys, transaction-local tenant GUCs, and forced RLS with cross-tenant smoke coverage.
Task 060 implements canonical classifications, handling metadata, purpose/legal-basis/notice/consent metadata, retention metadata, lifecycle rules, and a shared default PII redaction boundary.
No REST route or OpenAPI operation is added; the new JSON Schemas describe internal governance metadata that future public APIs may consume.
No event payload or envelope changes are introduced; classification metadata instead establishes the minimization rules Task 007 and later event producers must obey.
No Connector SDK surface is changed; future connectors must consume the already frozen privacy capability rather than defining provider-local policy models.
Atomic migration 000006 adds privacy purpose/retention tables, forced RLS, monotonic lifecycle guards, purpose-class retention validation, and migration-history registration.

PII/secret classification and redaction are fail-closed on operational surfaces; database policy rows contain no subject payload, hard-delete is blocked, and tenant isolation is enforced at repository and RLS boundaries.
Task 060 defines governance metadata and legal basis but does not add approval policy; sensitive-operation approval remains owned by Task 017.
Append-only audit summary sanitization now consumes the privacy classifier in addition to secret redaction, preventing common PII fields/email/IP values from being persisted verbatim.
Optimistic policy versions prevent lost governance updates but do not change commerce inbox, reconciliation, or external-delivery idempotency semantics.
No webhook payload/delivery behavior changes; the classification contract records that secrets are forbidden and PII must be minimized on egress surfaces.
Structured logging now redacts common PII field/value shapes using the shared privacy boundary while preserving safe scalar operational fields.
Migration 000006 is expand-only but high-risk and requires a backup checkpoint; backup/restore rehearsals now verify registry data and RLS preservation.

Unit tests cover class metadata, purpose/retention lifecycle and no-PII leakage; static/runtime migration checks cover RLS, cross-tenant isolation, policy-class enforcement and immutable retire-only lifecycle.
